data.headline: Button styles
data.intro: Each row shows one style: a button, a button with a leading icon, a disabled button, and the same three as links.

styles.name: Filled
styles.note: The highest emphasis. The class btn-primary renders the same.
styles.label: Button

styles.name: Tonal
styles.note: A middle ground between filled and outlined.
styles.label: Button

styles.name: Outlined
styles.note: Medium emphasis, for actions that are important but not primary.
styles.label: Button

styles.name: Elevated
styles.note: A tonal button with a shadow, for when the button needs lifting off a patterned surface.
styles.label: Button

styles.name: Text
styles.note: The lowest emphasis, for the least prominent actions.
styles.label: Button

data.sizesIntro: Each row shows one size: round filled, round tonal with an icon, square outlined, square elevated with an icon, disabled, and a text link.

sizes.name: Small, 40px
sizes.note: The class btn-sm. A button with no size class is this size.
